name: datetimepicker.js
description: A flexible and customizable JavaScript DateTime picker supporting inline, input, and button modes, with calendar, time sliders, UTC/local toggle, Day of Year support, and Bootstrap 5 styling.

scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && npx esbuild datetimepicker.js --minify --outfile=dist/datetimepicker.min.js && npx esbuild datetimepicker.css --minify --outfile=dist/datetimepicker.min.css
